mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position_state (tenant_id, resource_id, reserved_until, reserved_by_run, updated_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, NULL, #{param3}, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_id) DO UPDATE SET reserved_until = NULL, reserved_by_run = EXCLUDED.reserved_by_run, updated_at = now() WHERE (position_state.plate_id IS NULL OR position_state.plate_id = '') AND (position_state.reserved_by_run IS NULL OR (position_state.reserved_until IS NOT NULL AND position_state.reserved_until < now()) OR position_state.reserved_by_run = EXCLUDED.reserved_by_run)

INSERT INTO position_state (tenant_id, resource_id, reserved_until, reserved_by_run, updated_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, now() + #{param3}::interval, #{param4}, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_id) DO UPDATE SET reserved_until = now() + #{param3}::interval, reserved_by_run = EXCLUDED.reserved_by_run, updated_at = now() WHERE (position_state.plate_id IS NULL OR position_state.plate_id = '') AND (position_state.reserved_by_run IS NULL OR (position_state.reserved_until IS NOT NULL AND position_state.reserved_until < now()) OR position_state.reserved_by_run = EXCLUDED.reserved_by_run)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position_state (tenant_id, resource_id, plate_id, occupied_since, occupied_by_run, updated_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, now(), #{param4}, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, resource_id) DO UPDATE SET plate_id = EXCLUDED.plate_id, occupied_since = now(), occupied_by_run = EXCLUDED.occupied_by_run, reserved_until = NULL, reserved_by_run = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE position_state.plate_id IS NULL OR position_state.plate_id = ''
mapper.select: SELECT plate_id FROM position_state WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND resource_id = #{param2} AND plate_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE position_state SET reserved_until = NULL, reserved_by_run = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND reserved_until IS NOT NULL AND reserved_until < now()
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS "id", r.code AS "code", r.name AS "name", r.kind::text AS "kind", ps.plate_id AS "plateId", ps.reserved_until AS "reservedUntil", ps.reserved_by_run AS "reservedByRun", ps.occupied_since AS "occupiedSince", d.id AS "parentId", d.code AS "parentCode" FROM resource_node r LEFT JOIN position_state ps ON ps.resource_id = r.id AND ps.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN resource_node d ON d.id = r.parent_id AND d.kind = 'device' WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.kind IN ('incubator', 'storage', 'transfer_point') AND (r.parent_id = #{param2} OR r.parent_id IN (SELECT id FROM resource_node WHERE parent_id = #{param2} AND kind = 'device')) ORDER BY r.code

mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM resource_node r LEFT JOIN position_state ps ON ps.resource_id = r.id AND ps.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.parent_id = #{param2} AND r.kind IN ('incubator', 'storage', 'transfer_point') AND (ps.plate_id IS NULL OR ps.plate_id = '') AND (ps.reserved_by_run IS NULL OR (ps.reserved_until IS NOT NULL AND ps.reserved_until < now())) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 1

mapper.select: UPDATE device_state SET current_run_id = #{runId}, status = 'running', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND resource_id = #{resourceId} AND (current_run_id IS NULL OR current_run_id = #{runId} -- 幽灵锁可回收：锁指向的 run **已经不存在或已终态** ⇒ 这把锁没人会 -- 再还回来（run 被删/跑完/被隔离），不回收就是"这台设备凭空永远忙"。 -- 2026-11-11 实测：验收脚本清理时删掉了自己的 run，设备锁还指着那个 -- 已删的 run ⇒ 后续实验永远抢不到这台设备（T1 一直 running）。 -- ⚠ **paused / running / queued 的锁不能回收** —— 那些 run 还要恢复， -- 设备是它的（回收 ⇒ 别的 run 抢走它暂停时占着的设备）。 OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.id = device_state.current_run_id AND r.status IN ('draft','pending','planned','queued','running','paused'))) RETURNING resource_id
mapper.update: UPDATE device_state ds SET current_run_id = NULL, status = 'idle', updated_at = now() WHERE ds.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ds.current_run_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM run r WHERE r.id = ds.current_run_id AND r.status::text IN ('completed','failed','aborted','cancelled'))

UPDATE device_state ds SET current_run_id = NULL, status = 'idle', last_error = '锁超时自动释放', updated_at = now() WHERE ds.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ds.current_run_id IS NOT NULL AND ds.updated_at < now() - (#{ttlSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval
